eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* IBD patients with clinical remission Crohn's disease: HBI \< 5 Ulcerative colitis: Partial Mayo score 0-1 w/o bloody stool
* Age \> 18 years
* PSQI score \> 5
* No medical adjustment for 2 months and use corticosteroids not more than Prednisolone equivalent 5 mg/day

Exclusion Criteria:

* Current alcohol or substance abuse
* High risk for OSA (STOP-BANG score \> 5)
* Psychiatric problem: PHQ-9 score \> 20 or GAD-7 score \> 20
* Hypnotic drug use and unable to hold for 1week before trial
* Shift worker

identificationModule.briefTitle: Efficacy of Melatonin Treatment on Sleep Quality Improvement in Inflammatory Bowel Disease Patients With Clinical Remission
